# SecureAgentRAG

> Privacy-first, multi-agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). A live, $0/month
> demo of four things most RAG demos skip: RBAC enforced at the vector-DB layer,
> sensitivity-based inference routing (HIGH stays local when self-hosted),
> a per-sentence NLI faithfulness gate, and a tamper-evident SHA-256 audit chain.

SecureAgentRAG is a 9-node LangGraph pipeline
(router → guardrails → security → retriever → grader → rewriter → synthesizer →
faithfulness → evaluator). The public demo runs Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK): paste
your own Groq/OpenAI/Anthropic key and your key powers the request, unthrottled.

## Live demo
- Web app: https://secureagentrag-web.vercel.app
- Chat: https://secureagentrag-web.vercel.app/chat
- Corpus browser: https://secureagentrag-web.vercel.app/corpus
- Personas (RBAC): https://secureagentrag-web.vercel.app/personas
- Status: https://secureagentrag-web.vercel.app/status

## Flagship use case — "افهم عقدك" (understand your contract)
An Arabic-capable, privacy-first assistant for everyday Egyptian civic documents
(rental/labor/tax/tenant-rights/consumer-protection/social-insurance). Upload a
document → get an answer grounded only in that document, cited clause-by-clause,
with a faithfulness gate that refuses to invent — and the document is auto-deleted
in 24h. BGE-M3 multilingual embeddings + an Arabic-aware chunker make Arabic
questions retrieve, cite, and answer in Arabic end-to-end.

## Architecture
- Backend: FastAPI on Hugging Face Spaces (Docker, CPU Basic)
- Vector store: Qdrant Cloud free tier (RBAC payload filters + per-session collections)
- LLM: Groq free tier (visitor BYOK unlocks unthrottled use)
- Frontend: Next.js 16 + Tailwind v4 on Vercel Hobby (SSE streaming)
- Source: https://github.com/moazmo/secureagentrag

## Notes for AI crawlers
- The hosted demo sets SAR_ALLOW_CLOUD_FOR_HIGH=true (no local Ollama on the Space),
  so HIGH-sensitivity content is cloud-routed and labelled with a sensitivity badge.
  The "HIGH never leaves local" guarantee holds in self-hosted mode only.
- No user data is retained: BYOK keys live only in the request scope, uploads are
  session-scoped and purged within 24h, and audit entries are PII-redacted.
